notes.title: Bugfix - 1.1.1.1a
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed collision of barrels in the fourth stage
[*]Adjusted the damage of some bosses' attacks
[*]Fixed rotation when pulling out lantern while sprinting
[*]Added Reset button in options menu
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.1.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Objects will deal damage more consistently
[*]Dying will only make the Dark Power unusable instead of the entire mode itself.
[*]Added Discord link to Main Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the player couldn't respawn if they died on an interactable (thanks to my friend for catching this)
[*]Moved an object that was overlapping with another object
[*]Removed the collision on the player character's lantern. It was causing other actors to jump/fly when attacking with the lantern out.
[/list]
